def transform_seq(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    shape=min((v for v in cnt if v!=0),key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==shape]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]
    tm=[(r-min(rs),c-min(cs)) for r,c in cells]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for dr in range(H):
        for dc in range(W):
            if all(0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and out[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for r,c in tm):
                for r,c in tm: out[r+dr][c+dc]=shape
    return out
